name: 5-fluoro-AET
summary: 5-Fluoro-AET, also known as 5-fluoro-α-ethyltryptamine or by the code name PAL-545, is a substituted tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin–dopamine releasing agent (SDRA) and as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.

pharmacology.text: Its EC50 values for monoamine release are 36.6 nM for serotonin, 5,334 nM for norepinephrine, and 150 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes. Its EC50 at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor is 246 nM and its Emax at the receptor is 87%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonin receptor agonist; Entactogen
